proposition_1_eg1_identity.note: Corr(τ,g) ≈ 0.48 is non-negligible. Identity E(σ²) = E(τ)E(g) + Cov(τ,g) holds exactly. The simpler E(σ²) ≈ E(τ) is an approximation.

interpretation.A4_constrained: θ₁ ratio = 0.7808 < 1: VRP correction via θ₁ (21.9% discount)
interpretation.A4f_free_omega: θ₁ ratio = 1.9566 > 1 but E(g) = 0.4821: VRP split between E(g) and θ₁

proposition_2_vrp_auto_correction.verdict: Constrained: VRP fully in θ₁. Free: VRP split between θ₁ and E(g). Both channels are economically meaningful.

method_A_direct_g.description: g_t from model recursion vs VRP (weak because τ already removed VRP)

method_B_g_proxy.description: σ²/VIX²_daily (K988b method) vs VRP — measures realized/implied ratio

proposition_3_g_tracks_vrp.verdict: Method B confirms GARCH filtering amplifies VRP tracking. Direct g is orthogonal to VRP by construction (τ absorbs VRP signal).

ks_test_standardized.interpretation: Similar shapes confirm both models have same GARCH dynamics; scale differs.

not_relabeling_evidence.1_parametric_identification: τ = θ₀+θ₁VIX²; θ parameters are estimated by MLE with economic interpretation (VRP correction)
not_relabeling_evidence.2_dynamic_structure: g follows GJR-GARCH; imposes autoregressive + asymmetry constraints. Not arbitrary residual.
not_relabeling_evidence.3_scale_identification: E(g)=1 constraint identifies scale. Without it, (cτ, g/c) is observationally equivalent for any c>0.
not_relabeling_evidence.5_vs_spline_garch: Engle & Rangel (2008): τ = time spline, no external variable, no VRP link
not_relabeling_evidence.6_vs_garch_midas: Engle et al. (2013): τ = Beta-weighted MIDAS, monthly+, indirect VRP link via macro
not_relabeling_evidence.7_our_innovation: A4f: τ = daily VIX² (risk-neutral → physical measure bridge), direct VRP auto-correction

references: Bollerslev, Tauchen & Zhou (2009). Expected Stock Returns and VRP. RFS 22(11):4463-4492.
Engle, Ghysels & Sohn (2013). Stock Market Volatility. RES 95(3):776-797.
